Under *Double Clutch* p. 123–124, the Man-At-Arms receives 3 free Standard Hardpoints ($\lfloor\text{Body}/3\rfloor = 3$): `1` Standard Hardpoint split into `2×` Small Hardpoints (`Weapon Mount - Small x2` for Crimson Wasp eye lasers, DC p. 124), `1` Standard Hardpoint for the `Drone Rack (Small)`, and `1` Standard Hardpoint for the `Ram Plate` (DC p. 144), consuming zero extra hardpoints (`3/3` Standard eq.). Mod slot balance (`0` category shifts required): **10/10 Chassis** (Structural Integrity 5 + Realistic Features 4 + Pop-Out Concealment - Small x2 [0.5 × 2 = 1] = 10), **10/10 Powertrain** (Vector Thrust 5 + Improved Acceleration 2 [2, DC p. 134] + Top Speed Increase 3 [3, DC p. 138] = 10), and **10/10 Electronics** (Chameleon Coating 4 [2] + Passive Stealth Features [1] + Enhanced Sensors 9 [7, Base 2 -> 9, DC p. 142] = 10, 100% allocated). `Hydrocarbon Fuel Converter` and `Nitro Boost` (`BRYNNE` & `CEDAR` lateral thigh capacitors) are retained physically for narrative/RP purposes only (`0` Powertrain slots, `0¥`). Anthroform cyberlimbs are standard equipment per DC p. 131 and consume 0 drone mod slots.
